Woatsɔ dɔwɔwɔ ŋuti nyatakakaa ana dɔnɔa ƒe dodokpɔ mamlɛtɔ manɔmee eye hehenala la ƒe mɔɖeɖe manɔmee.
Nusɔsrɔ̃a ƒe ɖoɖo kple dodokpɔ ƒe dzidzenuwo: Dzeside mamlɛtɔ anye akpa eve:
50% ƒe dodokpɔ le hehenala ŋu.
50% ƒe dodokpɔ le nuwɔna ŋuti nyatakakaa ŋu.
